description: Reassemble every component on the current EasyEDA schematic page into named functional blocks. The blocks must cover the whole page. A checkpoint is saved before replacement, and failures restore it automatically. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id. For circuit workflow docs, read: /scratch/pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

auto_resize_page.description: Shrink or grow the schematic drawing sheet to the smallest standard format that fits the layout inside its frame and title block.

blocks.description: All current-page components grouped by block name.

draw_block_box.description: Draw Copilot-managed boxes and labels around functional blocks.

name: beautify_schematic_on_current_page
title: Beautify EasyEDA Schematic
